description.narrative: The development objective of Tax Administration Modernization Project for Moldova is to improve revenue collection, tax compliance and taxpayer services. This project has five components. 1) The first component, Tax Policy Reform, will finance a comprehensive review of the legal framework including: (i) revisions to align Moldovan legislation on Value Added Tax (VAT) and Excise Duties in line with the European Union (EU)-Moldova Association Agreement; (ii) options to strengthen legislation and administrative practices to counter international profit shifting and base erosion risks for the Moldovan tax base and relevant capacity building in State Tax Service (STS) and Ministry of Finance (MoF); (iii) strengthening national tax legislation by ensuring consistency of primary and secondary lax legislation, access to tax rulings and improvements in administration of local taxes and fees. 2) The second component, Institutional Development, will support changes to STss organizational structure and strengthen back office functions. 3) The third component, Operational Development, will finance functions that deal directly with taxpayers. 4) The fourth component, Information Technology (IT) Infrastructure and System Modernization, will acquire and implement an Integrated Tax Management System that will unify IT support for all business functions including: user role management and security, transaction audit trails and logging, taxpayer registration, returns processing, accounting, payment processing, collections and enforcement, objections and appeals, audit, risk assessment, management reporting, case work flow, data warehouse and business intelligence tools, a document management system and a portal interface. 5) The fifth component, Project Management and Change Management,will finance: national and international consultants to support procurement, financial management and technical implementation; international advisors for IT project management, training and change management; and operating costs associated with the implementation of the Project
To support business survival and sustain employment in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic, through temporary tax relief, and improve taxpayer services in the Republic of Moldova

title.narrative: Number of hits to the STS web-site

comment.narrative: <p><strong>Achieved with results exceeded the target value</strong> The final target has been overachieved by 46%, as total number of hits to the STS website in 2023 reached 10.4 million compared to 7.15 planned. The data on the number of hits are related only to the STS’s new single website operational since April 1, 2021. The number of hits to the STS website has increased almost 3 times during the project lifetime.</p>

title.narrative: The Training Distance Learning System for the most important workflows developed

baseline.value: The list of training programs is not identified

target.value: All identified distance learning courses to support the most important workflows are developed and updated

comment.narrative:
<p><strong>Achieved. </strong>The STS developed 12 core distance learning programs and put them on the MOODEL platform in 2020. Three out of twelve identified training programs were developed by STS with support from development partners, including the US Treasury (on Taxpayer Service Manual) and SIDA (under Institutional Cooperation Project (2018-2021).</p>
<p>The STS is strengthening the sustainability of results achieved under TAMP by developing new courses and continuous staff training. As of project closure, the total number of online training materials (including video guides; course materials; video recordings of the training sessions etc) increased to 347.</p>

actual.value: All (12) identified distance learning courses to support the most important workflows were developed

comment.narrative: <p><strong>Achieved with results exceeding the target value.</strong> The final target has been overachieved as tax arrears decreased to 3.86 percent in 2023 compared to planned 6.48%. In 2023, the tax arrears reached – MDL 2,467.18 million of total revenues – MDL 63,992.88 million. Per the Results Framework in the original project paper, the indicator is measured as the share of tax arrears at the end of the year of tax revenues collected during the year. </p>

target.value: Satisfaction increase – 10% (compared to baseline) Final survey conducted with data disaggregated by gender. Results and suggests actions of the STS to address weaknesses are published on the STS website

comment.narrative: <p><strong>Not achieved. </strong>The STS conducted the final survey of legal entities and individuals in April – May 2023. The data of individual’s survey was disaggregated by gender. The final target against the baseline of 2018 have not been achieved. As per the 2023 final taxpayer survey, the satisfaction of legal entities decreased by 0.56 percent and that of individuals increased only by 2.82 percent. The reports with the results of the surveys and the 2023-2024 Action Plan prepared to address the weaknesses revealed during the final surveys are published on the STS’s website.  </p>

actual.value: Legal entities – 75.9%; Individuals – 71.1%. Satisfaction of legal entities decrease by 0.56%, and that of individuals increased by2.85%. Final survey results, conducted with data disaggregated by gender, and STss action plan to address the weaknesses revealed are published on the STS website.
